item.description: The Terraces at Bethany was a long time in the making.

item.title: SJ Valley lags in use of zero-emission vehicles
item.description: The eight counties in the San Joaquin Valley experience some of the highest levels of air pollution in California, with levels of several pollutants far above the statewide average.

item.title: WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOODS WITH 100% RENTALS AT RIVER ISLANDS
item.description: River Islands at Lathrop could be targeting a new housing market for the Northern San Joaquin Valley. And in doing so, it could end up building 2,000 homes in as little as two years.

item.title: $18.5M navigation center will house 190 homeless plus 8 transitional units
item.description: An industrial building that once was part of the Kodak photo processing network will house 190 homeless as Manteca’s permanent navigation center. The cost and extent of the project at 555 Industrial Park Drive was outlined in an environmental assessment required by the federal Housing and Urban Development completed last month.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Hurtado Garcia strikes twice in Lathrop boys soccer road win
item.description: The Lathrop boys soccer team returned to its winning ways Thursday, downing host Grace Davis 3-1 in a Western Athletic Conference game at Mary Grogan Community Park.

item.title: Akca’s 3 assists lift surging Sierra past Manteca
item.description: After struggling to get results in the first three-plus weeks of the season, Sierra is now off to the races in Valley Oak League play.

item.title: Mike Rosendin steps down after 29 years as Sierra cross country coach
item.description: Mike Rosendin has crossed the finish line in his storied career as Sierra High’s longtime cross country coach.

item.title: Can California avoid skyrocketing gas prices with 12% loss of refining capacity in 5 months?
item.description: The sentiment in Sacramento was “tough luck” if gas reaches $7 a gallon just a few years back. After all, it they said, it would force Californians out of their mobile planet killing machines powered by fossil fuels and into the anointed clean machines of the righteous green cabal that are also known as electric vehicles.

item.title: MUSD lauds efforts of City of Lathrop to enhance student pedestrian safety
item.description: The Manteca Unified School District is appreciative of the collaborative efforts with the City of Lathrop when it comes to student safety.

item.title: Manteca’s method of managing homeless relies on persistence, support, firmness, empathy & respect
item.description: Mike Kelly knew where to look. The Manteca Police officer, who has been a part of the city’s boots on the grounds approach to interacting with its homeless citizens for 10 years, turned his marked Ford Escape SUV black and white unit off Vanderbilt Circle and into a parking lot.
